en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a long, three‑storey barracks building with a mansard roof, dormer windows and decorative stonework. A tree‑lined street and an iron fence run along the front of the building; a few pedestrians are visible in the distance. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the location and the military unit stationed there, and a red handwritten number appears in the upper right corner.
